physicalNotes: Radius 0.475 +/- 0.014 solar radii from Barkaoui et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2084 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..38B/abstract): 330,458 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.453 +/- 0.029 solar masses from Barkaoui et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2084 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..38B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3551 +/- 49 K from Barkaoui et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2084 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..38B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
